logline: Two exes who made a high-school documentary together are forced back in front of a camera when that footage goes viral five years after their bitter breakup.

renewal.note: Single-season limited series; concluded January 25, 2022. Despite modest domestic SBS ratings (averaging 3.9 percent), the series ranked in Netflix's global Top 10 in multiple markets.

bollymeter.basis: 86-percent Rotten Tomatoes score; IMDb at 8.2; Netflix global Top 10 presence in multiple markets confirmed international reach beyond the modest domestic SBS ratings.

seasons.review_body: Our Beloved Summer aired on SBS from December 6, 2021, to January 25, 2022, highlighting the gap between domestic cable performance and streaming reach: domestic ratings averaged 3.9 percent while the series ranked in Netflix's global Top 10 across multiple markets. Rotten Tomatoes scored it at 86 percent, with Kim Da-mi and Choi Woo-shik, previously paired off-screen during The Witch, bringing chemistry that feels earned rather than constructed. IMDb audiences settled at 8.2. The screenplay by Lee Na-eun uses a creative structure that weaves the documentary-within-the-drama device into the romance while keeping it from feeling contrived. The show received the Director's Award at the 2021 SBS Drama Awards. The craft supports it as a well-crafted romantic drama, lifted by lead performances above the genre's typical baseline.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.review_body: Our Beloved Summer Season 1 Episode 1 aired December 6, 2021 on SBS with simultaneous Netflix streaming as the premiere of a 16-episode romance that earned 86 percent on Rotten Tomatoes and an IMDb audience score of 8.2. The series ranked in Netflix’s global Top 10 across multiple markets despite a domestic SBS average of 3.9 percent. Kim Da-mi and Choi Woo-shik, previously paired off-screen during The Witch, bring chemistry that reads as earned rather than constructed. The premiere establishes the split timeline with brisk efficiency: the high-school documentary from five years ago sits against the present-tense awkwardness of a forced professional reunion. The screenplay by Lee Na-eun allows both leads to make their characters’ avoidance of each other fully legible through performance alone, without exposition or voiceover framing. The series received the Director’s Award at the 2021 SBS Drama Awards.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes the split timeline with brisk efficiency: the documentary from five years ago, the present-tense awkwardness of a forced reunion, and the clear incompatibility the couple have built into their adult identities. The first episode works because both leads make their characters’ avoidance of each other fully legible without exposition.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Yeon-su and Ung’s first encounter since the breakup - a scene that tells the audience everything about the cost of their split before any backstory is provided.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 16
episode_reviews.review_body: Our Beloved Summer Season 1 Episode 16 aired January 25, 2022 on SBS with simultaneous Netflix streaming as the finale of a 16-episode series that earned 86 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, an IMDb audience score of 8.2, and Netflix Global Top-10 placement across multiple markets. The series received the Director's Award at the 2021 SBS Drama Awards. The finale uses its documentary-within-the-drama structural device one final time to close the romantic and narrative arcs simultaneously. Audience reviews focused on the tonal balance the episode maintains - it does not overstate the resolution or sentimentalise beyond what 15 episodes of characterisation supports, and it does not undercut either. For a genre in which excessive restraint and excessive sentiment are equally common failure modes, the finale's calibration was the aspect most noted by critics and viewers who had followed the series from its December premiere.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale ties the documentary thread and the romantic resolution together through sustained character work. The show does not overstate the reunion and does not undercut it either, striking a tonal balance that stands out for the genre.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final scene with the documentary playing - the show using its central structural device one last time to make the emotional point directly.
